language.name: Ledger Line
language.rationale: This design language reflects The Ledger's commitment to stark, typographic, and authoritative journalism. The monochrome palette and precise forms convey seriousness and integrity, while generous spacing and measured motion maintain a calm, focused presence suitable for public-broadcast news.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
